        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6d</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6d">Released</a> on July 28, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Feat] Add validation endpoint @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5894)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Contributing instruction update command to build docs. @Chadha93 (#5897)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 5.12.1 to 5.14.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5858)</li>
  <li>Fix panic during reset of database @MUzairS15 (#5893)</li>
  <li>[Server] Multi-Cluster: Fix k8s context duplication @gr455 (#5867)</li>
  <li>[Fix] WS connection hijacking issue @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5844)</li>
  <li>Keep the type of the services to be same. @Aisuko (#5841)</li>
  <li>Add k8s middleware to filter handler @Revolyssup (#5797)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update description for mesheryctl homebrew tap @nishantwrp (#5784)</li>
  <li>state fixed For docker extension @harkiratsm (#5781)</li>
  <li>Fix contradicting fields in k8s registered schema @Revolyssup (#5777)</li>
  <li>Changed the order of image  @harkiratsm (#5763)</li>
  <li>refactor: Do not purge the database @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5753)</li>
  <li>fix: Add essential middlewares for extension endpoints @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5751)</li>
  <li>Upgrade k8s.io to 0.24 @Revolyssup (#5639)</li>
  <li>fixed the upload of image for docker extension @harkiratsm (#5748)</li>
  <li>fix: CustomResourceDefintions ref resolve @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5744)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Update meshkit release and kompose conversion logic @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5719)</li>
  <li>docker extension empty state fixed  @harkiratsm (#5684)</li>
  <li>Remove extranous log including cert data  @Revolyssup (#5698)</li>
  <li>Fixed logout buton alignment in meshery extension @Rohith-Raju (#5685)</li>
  <li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
  <li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
  <li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
  <li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
  <li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
  <li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
  <li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
  <li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
  <li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
  <li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
  <li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
  <li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
  <li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix capture and handle expired token  @MUzairS15 (#4956)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): automatically create meshconfig if not present @nishantwrp (#5877)</li>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): exit with non-zero error code on failure @nishantwrp (#5880)</li>
  <li>Misleading error on invalid meshconfig @manikmmalhotra (#5854)</li>
  <li>Create logic for screenshot capture in mesheryctl ref @alphaX86 (#5778)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix golang unit tests @alphaX86 (#5843)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">app onboard</code> silent fail @gr455 (#5679)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump github.com/spf13/cobra from 1.4.0 to 1.5.0 @dependabot (#5729)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Meshery-Extension] setup single source of truth for svgs @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5885)</li>
  <li>[UI] Confirmation modal deploy and undeploy color update @Chadha93 (#5903)</li>
  <li>[UI] Replaced Confirmation Modal’s Undeploy Color @legendarykamal (#5842)</li>
  <li>Update Patterns to Designs in Delete Modal and Toaster @legendarykamal (#5891)</li>
  <li>Added logic to view switch  @harkiratsm (#5892)</li>
  <li>[RJSF] Fix duplicate prop assignment in rjsf @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5889)</li>
  <li>Solves Session Expired Modal  @legendarykamal (#5835)</li>
  <li>GraphQL subscriptions PR #5657 @Abhishek-kumar09 (#5686)</li>
  <li>
    <table>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>Updated empty state of confirmation modal</td>
          <td>CU-2kcvd3c @asubedy (#5868)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </li>
  <li>[UI] Static Assets: custom font @leecalcote (#5869)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 5.14.0 to 5.14.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#5859)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 4.8.0 to 4.8.1 in /ui @dependabot (#5860)</li>
  <li>
    <table>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>uniformaity in opacity of rjsf</td>
          <td>CU-2khg6f6 @warunicorn19 (#5864)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6e</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6e">Released</a> on July 29, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Feat] Add validation endpoint @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5894)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Contributing instruction update command to build docs. @Chadha93 (#5897)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 5.12.1 to 5.14.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5858)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

  <li>Create logic for screenshot capture in mesheryctl ref @alphaX86 (#5778)</li>
  <li>docs: fix ui lint commands in contributing.md @nishantwrp (#5829)</li>
  <li>fixed the repetition in table of contents @manikmmalhotra (#5809)</li>
  <li>Added meshery broader capability  @harkiratsm (#5805)</li>
  <li>fixed the command from meshery/homebrew-tap to meshery/tap @manikmmalhotra (#5810)</li>
  <li>Fixed Typos in architecture.md  @bishal7679 (#5792)</li>
  <li>Missing a “git” in the command in docs/readme @manikmmalhotra (#5780)</li>
  <li>Highlight current tab on scroll in table of content in navigation @manikmmalhotra (#5762)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Add KubeSphere App Store as a supported platform for Meshery @codrAlxx (#5717)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6fb</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6fb">Released</a> on August 06, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[CI] Move to tar.gz for mesheryctl packages @leecalcote (#5983)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix svc type of meshery-operator  @theBeginner86 (#5976)</li>
  <li>[chore] Revert meshery-operator svc to ClusterIP @theBeginner86 (#5972)</li>
  <li>Replacing operator service type to LoadBalancer. @Aisuko (#5957)</li>
  <li>[Feat] Add validation endpoint @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5894)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Contributing instruction update command to build docs. @Chadha93 (#5897)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 5.12.1 to 5.14.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5858)</li>
  <li>Fix panic during reset of database @MUzairS15 (#5893)</li>
  <li>[Server] Multi-Cluster: Fix k8s context duplication @gr455 (#5867)</li>
  <li>[Fix] WS connection hijacking issue @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5844)</li>
  <li>Keep the type of the services to be same. @Aisuko (#5841)</li>
  <li>Add k8s middleware to filter handler @Revolyssup (#5797)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update description for mesheryctl homebrew tap @nishantwrp (#5784)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc.6fd</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc.6fd">Released</a> on August 12, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Meshkit update @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6016)</li>
  <li>[Fix] Problem with handling multiple workloads at api/meshmodel/validate @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5999)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix: Read response body before reusing request @gr455 (#6001)</li>
  <li>Migrate installation script to meshery.io repo @nishantwrp (#5995)</li>
  <li>Fix uncompressing of tar files in docker extension @nishantwrp (#5987)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl]: change meshery bash script to consider the .tar.gz format @hexxdump (#5911)</li>
  <li>[CI] Move to tar.gz for mesheryctl packages @leecalcote (#5983)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix svc type of meshery-operator  @theBeginner86 (#5976)</li>
  <li>[chore] Revert meshery-operator svc to ClusterIP @theBeginner86 (#5972)</li>
  <li>Replacing operator service type to LoadBalancer. @Aisuko (#5957)</li>
  <li>[Feat] Add validation endpoint @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5894)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Contributing instruction update command to build docs. @Chadha93 (#5897)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 5.12.1 to 5.14.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5858)</li>
  <li>Fix panic during reset of database @MUzairS15 (#5893)</li>
  <li>[Server] Multi-Cluster: Fix k8s context duplication @gr455 (#5867)</li>
  <li>[Fix] WS connection hijacking issue @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5844)</li>
  <li>Keep the type of the services to be same. @Aisuko (#5841)</li>
  <li>Add k8s middleware to filter handler @Revolyssup (#5797)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update description for mesheryctl homebrew tap @nishantwrp (#5784)</li>
  <li>state fixed For docker extension @harkiratsm (#5781)</li>
  <li>Fix contradicting fields in k8s registered schema @Revolyssup (#5777)</li>
  <li>Changed the order of image  @harkiratsm (#5763)</li>
  <li>refactor: Do not purge the database @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5753)</li>
  <li>fix: Add essential middlewares for extension endpoints @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5751)</li>
  <li>Upgrade k8s.io to 0.24 @Revolyssup (#5639)</li>
  <li>fixed the upload of image for docker extension @harkiratsm (#5748)</li>
  <li>fix: CustomResourceDefintions ref resolve @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5744)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Update meshkit release and kompose conversion logic @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5719)</li>
  <li>docker extension empty state fixed  @harkiratsm (#5684)</li>
  <li>Remove extranous log including cert data  @Revolyssup (#5698)</li>
  <li>Fixed logout buton alignment in meshery extension @Rohith-Raju (#5685)</li>
  <li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
  <li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
  <li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
  <li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
  <li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
  <li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
  <li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
  <li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
  <li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
  <li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.0</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0">Released</a> on August 24, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Use meshkit error in logger @gr455 (#6084)</li>
  <li>[Refactor] Make the Errors Evaluation in Validation Lazy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6069)</li>
  <li>[Fix] Sum file @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6062)</li>
  <li>[Refactor] Rewrite ValidationHandler to take UI problems into consideration  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6059)</li>
  <li>Change status of CPX adapter in README @alphaX86 (#6024)</li>
  <li>Decode content from github api while downloading seed patterns @nishantwrp (#6026)</li>
  <li>Meshkit update @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6016)</li>
  <li>[Fix] Problem with handling multiple workloads at api/meshmodel/validate @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5999)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix: Read response body before reusing request @gr455 (#6001)</li>
  <li>Migrate installation script to meshery.io repo @nishantwrp (#5995)</li>
  <li>Fix uncompressing of tar files in docker extension @nishantwrp (#5987)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl]: change meshery bash script to consider the .tar.gz format @hexxdump (#5911)</li>
  <li>[CI] Move to tar.gz for mesheryctl packages @leecalcote (#5983)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix svc type of meshery-operator  @theBeginner86 (#5976)</li>
  <li>[chore] Revert meshery-operator svc to ClusterIP @theBeginner86 (#5972)</li>
  <li>Replacing operator service type to LoadBalancer. @Aisuko (#5957)</li>
  <li>[Feat] Add validation endpoint @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5894)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Contributing instruction update command to build docs. @Chadha93 (#5897)</li>
  <li>Bump terser from 5.12.1 to 5.14.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#5858)</li>
  <li>Fix panic during reset of database @MUzairS15 (#5893)</li>
  <li>[Server] Multi-Cluster: Fix k8s context duplication @gr455 (#5867)</li>
  <li>[Fix] WS connection hijacking issue @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5844)</li>
  <li>Keep the type of the services to be same. @Aisuko (#5841)</li>
  <li>Add k8s middleware to filter handler @Revolyssup (#5797)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update description for mesheryctl homebrew tap @nishantwrp (#5784)</li>
  <li>state fixed For docker extension @harkiratsm (#5781)</li>
  <li>Fix contradicting fields in k8s registered schema @Revolyssup (#5777)</li>
  <li>Changed the order of image  @harkiratsm (#5763)</li>
  <li>refactor: Do not purge the database @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5753)</li>
  <li>fix: Add essential middlewares for extension endpoints @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5751)</li>
  <li>Upgrade k8s.io to 0.24 @Revolyssup (#5639)</li>
  <li>fixed the upload of image for docker extension @harkiratsm (#5748)</li>
  <li>fix: CustomResourceDefintions ref resolve @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5744)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Update meshkit release and kompose conversion logic @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5719)</li>
  <li>docker extension empty state fixed  @harkiratsm (#5684)</li>
  <li>Remove extranous log including cert data  @Revolyssup (#5698)</li>
  <li>Fixed logout buton alignment in meshery extension @Rohith-Raju (#5685)</li>
  <li>[Refactor] Make use of validation and formatting functions exposed in Meshkit @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5650)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Refactor ws channels  in proxy @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5648)</li>
  <li>refactor: Refine ws connection for logout @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5647)</li>
  <li>Fix validation error and whitespacing bug @Revolyssup (#5644)</li>
  <li>Logout button move @warunicorn19 (#5641)</li>
  <li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#5637)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: dde ws undefined @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5636)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: Set isLogged to false after logging out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5635)</li>
  <li>[DDE] Fix: automatically change state once logged out @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5634)</li>
  <li>fixed issue with logo before login and added logout button @warunicorn19 (#5630)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix error code conflicts @gr455 (#5626)</li>
  <li>Allow provider to be set via query parameter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5627)</li>
  <li>Fix failing save context for incluster @Revolyssup (#5601)</li>
  <li>[dde] UI Change to adapt to the exposed server version @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5596)</li>
  <li>fix: Service mesh provisioning @sudo-NithishKarthik (#5595)</li>
  <li>exposed meshery server version in dde @warunicorn19 (#5591)</li>
  <li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#5593)</li>
  <li>Fix NATS connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5583)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix capture and handle expired token  @MUzairS15 (#4956)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix image ref in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> docs @alphaX86 (#5908)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.10</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.10">Released</a> on October 03, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Refactor] strings.Title has been deprecated @XDRAGON2002 (#6261)</li>
  <li>[Feat] Add support for registering components @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6250)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Update Meshery and Adapter version used in integration tests @leecalcote (#6243)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Displaying k8s context name on Meshsync modal @legendarykamal (#6306)</li>
  <li>Allow to delete last cluster @MUzairS15 (#6276)</li>
  <li>Export material ui avatar components @nishantwrp (#6304)</li>
  <li>Added tooltip to the application, filter and pattern cards @dara-soji (#6224)</li>
  <li>Add validation for pattern files @MUzairS15 (#6247)</li>
  <li>Aligned namespace and name in RJSF @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6246)</li>
  <li>[rjsf] some small fixes  @harkiratsm (#6239)</li>
  <li>Fix: GraphQL subscription bottleneck connecting to the server @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6244)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump gonum.org/v1/gonum from 0.11.0 to 0.12.0 @dependabot (#6299)</li>
  <li>[CI] Golang: Remove unnecessary redis pkg version pin @leecalcote (#6283)</li>
  <li>[CI] Golang: Removing unnecessary deps @leecalcote (#6275)</li>
  <li>Make core workflow more general @Revolyssup (#6263)</li>
  <li>Add sleep in E2E workflow for failing test @Revolyssup (#6262)</li>
  <li>fix: Lint checks @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6254)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update Meshery and Adapter version used in integration tests @leecalcote (#6243)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] HTML error in Compatibility Matrix @XDRAGON2002 (#6307)</li>
  <li>Fixed Typo @UtkarshMishra12 (#6292)</li>
  <li>Fixed Typo @UtkarshMishra12 (#6287)</li>
  <li>Fixed Typo @UtkarshMishra12 (#6281)</li>
  <li>[Docs] update the helm charts installation steps @XDRAGON2002 (#6238)</li>
  <li>Bump commonmarker from 0.23.5 to 0.23.6 in /docs @dependabot (#6233)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @UtkarshMishra12, @XDRAGON2002, @dara-soji, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @legendarykamal, @nishantwrp, @sudo-NithishKarthik and l5io</p>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.100</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.100">Released</a> on June 30, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.103</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.103">Released</a> on June 30, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[CI] mesheryctl: replace goreleaser deprecations @leecalcote (#8004)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] Add save button in edit modal for filters @theBeginner86 (#7992)</li>
  <li>[UI] Remove deploy/undeploy from UI @theBeginner86 (#7991)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add support to download, publish, unpublish, and clone wasm support @Chadha93 (#7969)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix: goreleaser halting the release process @Abhishek-kumar09 (#8003)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/jinzhu/copier from 0.0.0-20190924061706-b57f9002281a to 0.3.5 @dependabot (#7942)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @dependabot, @leecalcote and @theBeginner86</p>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.104</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.104">Released</a> on July 01, 2023</h4>

<h1 id="whats-new">What’s New</h1>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Maintenance] Component Updater: Go package upgrades @leecalcote (#8008)</li>
  <li>[Maintenance] Go package upgrades @leecalcote (#8007)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Stable Release Channel: Release Notes Mailer @leecalcote (#8010)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>added tests for healthcheck @Freedisch (#7896)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Reusable Tooltip and added missing tooltips @sudhanshutech (#7615)</li>
  <li>Added a white helm logo for dark mode @souravpy (#7598)</li>
  <li>Bump @paciolan/remote-component from 2.12.1 to 2.13.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7244)</li>
  <li>Published icon fix in design card @duckling69 (#7808)</li>
  <li>fix-rows-per-page-in-mesh-model-summary @HarshDobariya79 (#7988)</li>
  <li>Fix: crash of Form on ui:widget checkbox @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7997)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Stable Release Channel: Release Notes Mailer @leecalcote (#8010)</li>
  <li>Bump @paciolan/remote-component from 2.12.1 to 2.13.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7244)</li>
  <li>[CI] Move Goreleaser to latest version - Update build-and-release-stable.yml @leecalcote (#8006)</li>
  <li>Using conditions to control job execution [Fixes #7754] @anshgoyalevil (#7787)</li>
  <li>[chore] feat: add test plan sheets @Ghat0tkach (#7836)</li>
  <li>[Governance] Document update to include role descriptions @leecalcote (#7968)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Fix position of buttons in the code snippets on quick start page. @chinu-anand (#7264)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Documentation Enhancement  @thisiskaransgit (#7914)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.105</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.105">Released</a> on July 07, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump tough-cookie from 4.0.0 to 4.1.3 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#8099)</li>
  <li>Helm Chart to have the “meshery” namespace @Freedisch (#8044)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix published filters not appearing @Meyazhagan (#8083)</li>
  <li>[Meshmodel] Update WASMFilter component @MUzairS15 (#8085)</li>
  <li>[Meshmodel] Add support for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields</code> @MUzairS15 (#8081)</li>
  <li>[Meshmodel] Add new relationship <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">inventory_wallet</code>. @MUzairS15 (#8088)</li>
  <li>Revert “[Maintenance] Component Updater: Go package upgrades” @MUzairS15 (#8036)</li>
  <li>Revert “[Maintenance] Go package upgrades” @leecalcote (#8030)</li>
  <li>Storybook drawer component @senali-d (#7967)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Remove <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">apply</code> subcommand from <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl exp filter</code> @Boombag0607 (#8012)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Filter: View not accepting name; requiring ID? @suhail34 (#8061)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Filter: List subcommand dysfunctional @suhail34 (#8033)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Filter publish, unpublish, clone  @Chadha93 (#8035)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 13.2.4 to 13.4.9 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8101)</li>
  <li>[chore] fix grid view action btns @theBeginner86 (#8103)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.21.8 to 7.22.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8075)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 12.15.0 to 12.16.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8018)</li>
  <li>[e2e Tests] error in github workflow by increasing the timeout in the test @codingmickey (#8082)</li>
  <li>Fix: Use Publish Modal and send it to extensions @Abhishek-kumar09 (#8098)</li>
  <li>Fix filter page crash on publishing filter @Yashsharma1911 (#8094)</li>
  <li>[fix] add custom textarea to have uniformity of textfield across rjsf @harkiratsm (#8086)</li>
  <li>Add Support for Credentials @harkiratsm (#7634)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.11.0 to 11.11.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8014)</li>
  <li>[UI] Settings: Added white background in Metrics @Yashsharma1911 (#8062)</li>
  <li>[Performance] Add support to use SSL certs for load testing. @MUzairS15 (#8023)</li>
  <li>[UI] - Added count to tabs for meshmodel browser @UsmanDev09 (#8053)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix eslint Err @theBeginner86 (#8057)</li>
  <li>Bump lint-staged from 13.1.0 to 13.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#8025)</li>
  <li>feat: add a custom native select widget in rjsf @harkiratsm (#7930)</li>
  <li>added adapters in extensions @vaibhav135 (#8013)</li>
  <li>Bump autoprefixer from 10.4.13 to 10.4.14 in /ui @dependabot (#8026)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons from 6.2.0 to 6.4.0 in /ui @dependabot (#8027)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>update core wasm filter svg with height and width @Abhishek-kumar09 (#8096)</li>
  <li>[Filters] Store filter as comp instance @MUzairS15 (#7963)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix Download of Filters @theBeginner86 (#8055)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 13.2.4 to 13.4.9 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8101)</li>
  <li>Update meshmodel issue template with label @leecalcote (#8105)</li>
  <li>[chore] fix grid view action btns @theBeginner86 (#8103)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.21.8 to 7.22.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8075)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 12.15.0 to 12.16.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8018)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.11.0 to 11.11.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8014)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix Download of Filters @theBeginner86 (#8055)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix eslint Err @theBeginner86 (#8057)</li>
  <li>Bump lint-staged from 13.1.0 to 13.2.3 in /ui @dependabot (#8025)</li>
  <li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.55.0 to 1.56.1 @dependabot (#8020)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.15.1 to 1.16.0 @dependabot (#8021)</li>
  <li>Bump autoprefixer from 10.4.13 to 10.4.14 in /ui @dependabot (#8026)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons from 6.2.0 to 6.4.0 in /ui @dependabot (#8027)</li>
  <li>[CI] Stable Release Channel: Reference Git Tag Name @leecalcote (#8011)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>changes in elements.scss @Rajivkumawat3 (#8065)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Remove Ruby version mandate @leecalcote (#8046)</li>
  <li>DOCS: update contributing guide with one addition of error while running make server @samyakshah3008 (#7961)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Boombag0607, @Chadha93, @Freedisch, @MUzairS15, @Meyazhagan, @Rajivkumawat3, @UsmanDev09, @Yashsharma1911, @abdullah1308, @codingmickey, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @leecalcote, @nebula-aac, @samyakshah3008, @senali-d, @suhail34, @theBeginner86 and @vaibhav135</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.107</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.107">Released</a> on July 12, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump semver from 6.3.0 to 6.3.1 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#8131)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Remote Provider: Model and Category Registration @theBeginner86 (#8145)</li>
  <li>Bump semver from 5.7.1 to 5.7.2 in /storybook @dependabot (#8140)</li>
  <li>Add unique count to meshmodel models, components @abdullah1308 (#8139)</li>
  <li>Update hierarchical-wallet.rego @MUzairS15 (#8136)</li>
  <li>fix user prefs @MUzairS15 (#8121)</li>
  <li>Update package-lock.json @Ritish134 (#8113)</li>
  <li>fix * available as version @MUzairS15 (#8123)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Created mesheryctl filter import and mesheryctl filter audit @abdullah1308 (#8063)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] App subcommand list and view dysfunctional @suhail34 (#8118)</li>
  <li>Fix/filter logs @jinronga (#8067)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump @mui/lab from 5.0.0-alpha.128 to 5.0.0-alpha.135 in /ui @dependabot (#8102)</li>
  <li>Bump @storybook/react from 7.0.7 to 7.0.26 in /ui @dependabot (#8100)</li>
  <li>Bump semver from 6.3.0 to 6.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8135)</li>
  <li>[UI] Filters Table :  Add Save Button To Filter Edit Modal @aabidsofi19 (#8146)</li>
  <li>Fix recursive API calls when multiple page changes immediately in configurations @HarshDobariya79 (#8032)</li>
  <li>Fix public tag filter in dark mode @VishwaRaval247 (#8134)</li>
  <li>Bump semver from 5.7.1 to 5.7.2 in /ui @dependabot (#8133)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fixed pagination issue in database overview @Meyazhagan (#8064)</li>
  <li>fixed extension infinite loading issue @vaibhav135 (#8058)</li>
  <li>
    <table>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>[UI] Added filter config</td>
          <td>CU-#85ztdxf0d @vaibhav135 (#8107)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </li>
  <li>[UI] Navigator :  Remove Conformance and fix extentions indentation @aabidsofi19 (#8127)</li>
  <li>removing unwanted console from rjsf #85zteqydm @duckling69 (#8120)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add MeshModel  Charts in Dashboard  @aabidsofi19 (#8110)</li>
  <li>Bump @mui/material from 5.11.15 to 5.13.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8112)</li>
  <li>Fix/filter logs @jinronga (#8067)</li>
  <li>[UI] MesheryFilters/FilterCard  : Add Download Button to Filter Card  @aabidsofi19 (#8073)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump @mui/lab from 5.0.0-alpha.128 to 5.0.0-alpha.135 in /ui @dependabot (#8102)</li>
  <li>Bump golang.org/x/oauth2 from 0.8.0 to 0.10.0 @dependabot (#8089)</li>
  <li>Bump @storybook/react from 7.0.7 to 7.0.26 in /ui @dependabot (#8100)</li>
  <li>Bump semver from 6.3.0 to 6.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8135)</li>
  <li>[Docs][WIP] Add contribution docs for MeshModel @Boombag0607 (#8119)</li>
  <li>Bump semver from 5.7.1 to 5.7.2 in /ui @dependabot (#8133)</li>
  <li>Bump @mui/material from 5.11.15 to 5.13.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#8112)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add Details/Summary for General Contribution Flow @ankur0904 (#7838)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Fixed responsiveness  @Ghat0tkach (#8117)</li>
  <li>Table display issue resolved @jayeshuk (#8068)</li>
  <li>[Docs][WIP] Add contribution docs for MeshModel @Boombag0607 (#8119)</li>
  <li>Fixed [UI] table in meshery docs @yash37158 (#8060)</li>
  <li>Update architecture.md @abdellani (#8116)</li>
  <li>Closes #8050 Added Build and Release: Stable Release Channel now includes automate… @ranjanmangla1 (#8115)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Aisuko, @Boombag0607, @Ghat0tkach, @HarshDobariya79, @MUzairS15, @Meyazhagan, @Ritish134, @VishwaRaval247, @aabidsofi19, @abdellani, @abdullah1308, @alphaX86, @ankur0904, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @duckling69, @harkiratsm, @jayeshuk, @jinronga, @leecalcote, @ranjanmangla1, @suhail34, @theBeginner86, @vaibhav135 and @yash37158</p>
