<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.142">Released</a> on September 19, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Remove adapter references in default env vars @leecalcote (#8810)</li>
  <li>[Docker Extension] Remove adapters from default configuration @leecalcote (#8811)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] fix color undefined @theBeginner86 (#8832)</li>
  <li>[UI] Notification Center: Update color of “No notifications to show” @leecalcote (#8828)</li>
  <li>Fix repetitive api calls and UI issues in connections page  @sudhanshutech (#8825)</li>
  <li>changed LoadTestTimerConfig and MeshAdapterConfigComponent to functional component @EraKin575 (#8781)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] fix color undefined @theBeginner86 (#8832)</li>

</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.143</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.143">Released</a> on September 20, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Update messages and logs to designs from patterns @Chadha93 (#8800)</li>
  <li>handle nil checks @MUzairS15 (#8844)</li>
  <li>watchtower label is added @zakisk (#8789)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>run error util for mesheryctl error codes replacement @MUzairS15 (#8846)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] Make MeshSyncEvents GraphQL  Subscription Configurable  @theBeginner86 (#8841)</li>
  <li>[Servre] Graphql/directives @MUzairS15 (#8836)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add Validation and Error Boundaries  @aabidsofi19 (#8833)</li>
  <li>Added Debug log for extension component @senali-d (#8845)</li>
  <li>fix pagination in meshmodel browser @sudhanshutech (#8838)</li>
  <li>converted class based dashboard component to functional component @EraKin575 (#8724)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Fix failing API docs build @theBeginner86 (#8850)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Fix failing API docs build @theBeginner86 (#8850)</li>
  <li>[Server] Added environments in Meshery @Yashsharma1911 (#8723)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @EraKin575, @MUzairS15, @Yashsharma1911, @aabidsofi19, @leecalcote, @senali-d, @sudhanshutech, @theBeginner86 and @zakisk</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.144</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.144">Released</a> on September 22, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>add docs for component generation and updater scripts @MUzairS15 (#8860)</li>
  <li>Fixed Meshary Integration Updater @ptdatta (#8774)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Designs] Fixes And Enhancements @aabidsofi19 (#8861)</li>
  <li>Fix Notification center bell icon toggle btn @aabidsofi19 (#8875)</li>
  <li>[UI] Enhancements :Notification center @aabidsofi19 (#8872)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix cluster resources dashboard not getting populated with data @MUzairS15 (#8873)</li>
  <li>[chore] Improve events for Server   @MUzairS15 (#8864)</li>
  <li>[UI] Notification inverse read indicator @aabidsofi19 (#8865)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.146</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.146">Released</a> on September 24, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>MeshKit v0.6.67 @leecalcote (#8897)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Notification Center: Increase size of unread indicator @leecalcote (#8891)</li>
  <li>[extensions] fix error msg @theBeginner86 (#8892)</li>
  <li>changed smi_results.js @EraKin575 (#8868)</li>
  <li>Connections row expand data with styling @senali-d (#8840)</li>
  <li>[Fix] k8s-switcher select-all @aabidsofi19 (#8876)</li>
  <li>[CI] e2e test job improvements @MarioArriaga92 (#8643)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>updating node versions workflow actions @Philip-21 (#8856)</li>
  <li>[CI] e2e test job improvements @MarioArriaga92 (#8643)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@EraKin575, @MUzairS15, @MarioArriaga92, @Philip-21, @aabidsofi19, @l5io, @leecalcote, @senali-d, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.148</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.148">Released</a> on September 27, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Helm] Values descriptions @leecalcote (#8935)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Update Helm Chart docs. @MUzairS15 (#8934)</li>
  <li>[Playground] Increase max file upload size.  @leecalcote (#8765)</li>
  <li>[Server] Do not refresh token when status code returned is <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">403</code>. @MUzairS15 (#8900)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix Dashboard Component @aabidsofi19 (#8888)</li>
  <li>fix useeffect and fetching @aabidsofi19 (#8943)</li>
  <li>fix: select all button issue meshery @captain-Akshay (#8933)</li>
  <li>Add a nullish check @aabidsofi19 (#8937)</li>
  <li>fix: Change prettier to error, and added eol to be LF @nebula-aac (#8916)</li>
  <li>[extensions] Fix Collaborator Extension Point Re-rendering @theBeginner86 (#8904)</li>
  <li>Fix for Navigation @Jougan-0 (#8877)</li>
  <li>[UI] feat: Setup prettier and moved lint-staged to its own file @nebula-aac (#8827)</li>
  <li>Revert “[extensions] Fix Collaborator Extension Point Re-rendering” @theBeginner86 (#8903)</li>
  <li>[extensions] Fix Collaborator Extension Point Re-rendering @theBeginner86 (#8893)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[extensions] Fix Collaborator Extension Point Re-rendering @theBeginner86 (#8904)</li>
  <li>add functionality to dynamically update the URL  @goldfishdolphin (#8899)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix useeffect and fetching @aabidsofi19 (#8943)</li>
  <li>fix: Change prettier to error, and added eol to be LF @nebula-aac (#8916)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: #8911 @Sumit21kumar (#8914)</li>
  <li>Changed “pertainting” to “pertaining” @nwanduka (#8920)</li>
  <li>Updated docs regarding linting/formatting in ui @akhilender-bongirwar (#8926)</li>
  <li>fix: Typo in Contributing to Meshery Server documentation #8924 @SAF2k (#8927)</li>
  <li>Typo in Contributing to Meshery Server/signoff @Ayush9026 (#8928)</li>
  <li>[DOC] fix: all the typos  @captain-Akshay (#8930)</li>
  <li>add functionality to dynamically update the URL  @goldfishdolphin (#8899)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Ayush9026, @Chadha93, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @SAF2k, @Sumit21kumar, @aabidsofi19, @akhilender-bongirwar, @captain-Akshay, @goldfishdolphin, @leecalcote, @nebula-aac, @nwanduka and @theBeginner86</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.152</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.152">Released</a> on October 01, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Extension] Docker: Update docker-compose.yaml @leecalcote (#8969)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: Updated format script to escape quotes @nebula-aac (#8967)</li>
  <li>[UI] Integrating CASL into Meshery UI @Mohith234 (#8945)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix Failing End to End Meshctl test @KiptoonKipkurui (#8973)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix MeshModel models reterival @theBeginner86 (#8941)</li>
  <li>[CI] Upgrade docker/setup-buildx-action and docker/setup-qemu-action @leecalcote (#8960)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Control the display of the intra-page navigator toolbar @leecalcote (#8947)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Enhance docs for /api/user/token @coder12git (#8968)</li>
  <li>Update URL with #anchor @goldfishdolphin (#8952)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Preparation for moving from Apps to Designs @leecalcote (#8953)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Added link for discussion forum @GLADI8R (#8955)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aisuko, @GLADI8R, @KiptoonKipkurui, @Mohith234, @aabidsofi19, @coder12git, @goldfishdolphin, @l5io, @leecalcote, @nebula-aac, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

  src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
